name: code-atlas
description: Code Atlas —— 把任意代码库扫成一份可读的中间数据（bundle），供人探索、供 AI 查询
//scripts: ⚠ test 与 test:ci 跑的是**两张不同的图**，改引擎/自检时两条都要跑：
test     —— 自检跑 dist（本仓库自己的图，有 src/ 与 configs/）；pretest 会先 `npm run scan:self`
把它**现扫**一遍 —— dist 以前靠手工重扫（上一次是 09-23），会悄悄过期：
'本地全绿'可能是在旧代码的图上跑出来的（2026-10-03 换新图时立刻露出一条红门）
test:ci  —— 与 .github/workflows/ci.yml **逐字一致**：现扫 tests/fixtures 再自检
两者内容不同 → '本地全绿'和 'CI 红'可以同时成立（2026-09-23 真踩过：一条门写死了 src/mcp.mjs，
dist 有、fixtures 没有 → 假红藏了一整轮）。

scripts.test: node tests/run-fixtures.mjs && node tests/probe-web-color.mjs && node tests/probe-runtime.mjs && node tests/mcp-selftest.mjs
scripts.test:ci: node tests/run-fixtures.mjs && node tests/probe-web-color.mjs && node tests/probe-runtime.mjs && node src/cli.mjs scan tests/fixtures --out tests/.out/ci --lang csharp,typescript,javascript,tsx,go,rust,lua && node tests/mcp-selftest.mjs tests/.out/ci
scripts.publish:sc: node tools/build-payload.mjs && dotnet publish launcher/CodeAtlas.Launcher.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -p:CodeAtlasEdition=full -p:CodeAtlasPayload=payload.zip -o publish-sc
scripts.publish:lite: node tools/build-payload.mjs --no-node && dotnet publish launcher/CodeAtlas.Launcher.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:CodeAtlasEdition=lite -p:CodeAtlasPayload=payload-lite.zip -o publish-lite
scripts.publish: npm run publish:sc && npm run publish:lite
